question: Should per-agent dashboard grouping/collapse be accepted as a bundled dashboard plugin feature after Wave 1, and should collapse state be transient UI state or persisted workspace preference?
rationale: The request is a new Control UI product surface layered on an unmerged dashboard architecture, so automation cannot safely choose final storage, visibility, or roadmap sequencing.

options.title: Stage After Wave 1
options.body: Keep this issue open as the Tier 3 dashboard item and implement it only after the workspace document and Workspaces UI contracts settle.

options.title: Fold Into Roadmap
options.body: Treat the request only as a subtask of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 until maintainers sequence the larger dashboard program.

options.title: Defer Grouping
options.body: Leave the initial dashboard flat and revisit per-agent grouping only after real multi-agent usage proves the need.

recommendation.title: Stage After Wave 1
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the Tier 3 dashboard item and implement it only after the workspace document and Workspaces UI contracts settle.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest maintainer-routing signal from the merged current-main plugin-tab seam and adjacent Control UI product boundary.
